title: GAIA
domain: Real-world questions needing reasoning, web research and file understanding.
good_to_know: Accept GAIA's access conditions on Hugging Face, then add a token in Settings → Data providers. Do not redistribute its questions or answers in a crawlable form.
Levels 1, 2 and 3 (53, 86 and 26 questions) split the 165 validation questions.
The authors' scorer gets the text after the last FINAL ANSWER: marker, or the whole reply without one.
Original is the paper's no-tools API baseline; choose an agent for files and web research. The paper ran it 3 times: 3 attempts per question.
upstream_limitations: The 301 test questions have private answers and are excluded from local scoring.
GAIA uses the live web; some evidence may have changed or become unavailable.
